title: AgenticNav: Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation as a Tool-Calling Harness
selection_reason: AgenticNav uses an on-demand depth tool, compact map representation, and selective memory recall in an MLLM navigation harness, concretely controlling the visual/context payload passed through the deployed agent.
